data.body:
[P2] Verify the complete deployed environment

Readback checks only the three `LMI_*` variables. A changed `AWS_RETRY_MODE` or additional SDK configuration variables still pass verification, and `configuration_identity` produces the same digest because those variables are absent from its inputs. Behaviorally different deployments can therefore appear as the same verified configuration. Compare the complete environment against the template's expected mapping, including `AWS_RETRY_MODE`, and include any supported extra variables in the configuration identity. Add environment-drift tests.
